Issue_Reported: During Dorsal Foot Vein test, performed on left foot, subject stopped responding to Phenylephrine. Research Pharmacist was asked to remix Phenylephrine which took 1.5 hours to receive new drug. New Phenylephrine was infused for 30 minutes without response so test was stopped at 12:00.
Action_Taken: Repeat Test (Requires approval by FAP Personnel)
Description_of_Action_Taken: Test personnel notified Coordinator on Duty. Coordinator on Duty contacted Study Lead who, in turn, contacted FAP Project Science. FAP Project Science has contacted CPHS for request to repeat Dorsal Foot Vein at another time. Leg Compliance was not performed and will be rescheduled with the repeat of Dorsal Foot Vein. Potential reschedule plan emailed to Study Lead, Ops Lead, Scheduler and backups by Coordinator on Duty. Issues notice completed.
Disposition_Comments: Recently, a new research pharmacist was hired at UTMB. The Cardiovascular Laboratory spoke with the new pharmacist and determined that the study drug was not properly prepared. Therefore, the subject's vein did not respond. The Cardiovascular Laboratory met with the new UTMB Research Pharmacist to discuss proper preparation of study medications. A repeat test was scheduled for April 13, 2009. The repeat test was successful and the subject tolerated it well. Since the Cardiovascular Lab personnel were able to meet with the new Research Pharmacist to clarify preparation of study medications, this should not be a problem in the future.

Lisa Milstead, FAP Cardio Subject Matter Expert, will update the Science Requirements Documents accordingly.
